interpretation: The engine can now rerun the coarse R4 H1/L1 likelihood on the two ParSpec source events when LALSuite is available. This moves the event-set blocker past GW170608-only data, but it remains nonclaiming because GW200129 has V1 public strain without an engine V1 R4 channel response, the source-event nuisance covariance is still reused from the GW170608 frontier, and no public ParSpec qEFT likelihood or engine-axis map is attached.
